flagged_for_v412: LILO-style documented library induction over the ARC solver corpus (arXiv:2310.19791)

methods.name: LILO documented library induction
methods.pitfalls: Auto-discovered libraries can hide game constants; require literal scans, held-out games, and reproduction gates before credit.
methods.what_it_takes_over_our_stack: Compress the solved ARC predicates, world-model fragments, and primitive ledger into named, documented operators retrievable by the .412 planner before candidate generation.

methods.name: DreamCoder wake-sleep library learning
methods.pitfalls: It only learns useful concepts if the DSL covers the real mechanic space; missing ARC primitives become compressed blind spots.
methods.what_it_takes_over_our_stack: Use wake-sleep abstraction discovery as the search-prior backbone over reusable solver programs and replayed ARC tasks.

methods.name: Stitch top-down synthesis for library learning
methods.pitfalls: Pure compression can produce opaque helpers; each abstraction needs docstrings, examples, and execution tests.
methods.what_it_takes_over_our_stack: Run corpus-guided compression over existing solver code to extract fast candidate abstractions before LILO documentation and retrieval.

methods.name: HYSYNTH context-free LLM approximation
methods.pitfalls: The surrogate can overfit prompt artifacts; keep verifier-returned counterexamples and cold controls in the loop.
methods.what_it_takes_over_our_stack: Fit task-local synthesis surrogates from LLM completions so the planner searches rule space instead of accepting one completion.

methods.name: CodeARC differential-query program induction
methods.pitfalls: A hidden target oracle is leakage if used at solve time; use it only for offline induction and separate final reproduction gates.
methods.what_it_takes_over_our_stack: Turn residual solver failures into targeted input/state queries and iteratively refine candidate predicates against differential tests.

methods.name: Executable ARC-AGI-3 world models
methods.pitfalls: Fresh agent and clean workspace isolation are load-bearing; cross-game file leakage invalidates generic transfer.
methods.what_it_takes_over_our_stack: Use the induce-verify-refactor-plan harness as the live transfer surface that consumes the documented primitive library.

methods.name: Loop-OWM composable object-centric world-model transfer
methods.pitfalls: ARC-1/2 transition prediction does not prove interactive game control; add action-cost, goal-inference, and reproduction checks.
methods.what_it_takes_over_our_stack: Represent ARC rules as demonstration-conditioned object-state transitions to test whether primitives transfer by structure.

methods.name: ARC-TGI generator-backed held-out task families
methods.pitfalls: Synthetic families can teach benchmark shortcuts; retain human-like constraints and public/private split discipline.
methods.what_it_takes_over_our_stack: Generate verified task-family variants so induced primitives face variation instead of memorizing one public trace.
